mapping_basis: MAPPPD represents Cape Bird as North/Middle/South component sites and Cape Crozier as east/west component sites, while Royds is a single site. The parent Cape Crozier site CROZ has no nest-count observations and is not included in the sum.

year_alignment.rule: Use MAPPPD season/year directly as the austral breeding-season start year for the Ross mark-resight analysis.
year_alignment.evidence: Relevant MAPPPD Ross nest-count observations are December records with season equal to year; e.g. 1996 counts have month=12, year=1996, season=1996.
year_alignment.choice_model: For first breeding season y, colony-size control uses breeding-pair count from season y-1.

annual_size_rule.ROYD: Require exactly one nonmissing ADPE nests count for ROYD in the year.
annual_size_rule.BIRD: Require exactly one nonmissing ADPE nests count for each of BRDN, BRDM and BRDS in the year, then sum the three counts.
annual_size_rule.CROZ: Require exactly one nonmissing ADPE nests count for each of CRZE and CRZW in the year, then sum the two counts.
annual_size_rule.duplicate_component_year: Treat the colony-year as missing; do not average, prioritize by accuracy, or select a record.
annual_size_rule.missing_component_year: Treat the colony-year as missing; do not impute.

eligibility_effect: A first-breeding event is eligible only when prior-year size exists for every colony in that individual's frozen candidate set. Missing size removes the event; it does not remove only the affected candidate.
claim_boundaries: The MAPPPD control is a nuisance covariate for colony size, not the Ross Island performance predictor.
Do not use later-year colony size or same-season post-settlement counts.
Do not average duplicate counts or impute missing component sites.
Do not redefine Bird or Crozier aggregation after individual movement outcomes are opened.
